title: 2004 carrier encounter: drop from 81,000 ft

tellings.quote: they had a craft at 80 I think it was 81,000 ft. It was like over 15 miles straight up in the air and they sent planes up to that area. And when they could just start seeing it on their instruments, it dropped down to 24 in above the water surface in under one second.

plain: In 2004, off California, an aircraft carrier group is said to have tracked a craft at about 81,000 feet, over 15 miles up. When planes were sent up and their instruments began to pick it up, it dropped to 24 inches above the water in under a second. Charlie Foltz tells this on Michels's show, passing on what someone he names told him, as a sign of motion no known aircraft can match.
